mechanism: Eager ForEach creates all song result rows on a large search page. LazyForEach creates visible rows as needed. Both revised variants request 1000 songs per page and advance offsets by actual response length; the original 30-song-page negative is archived.
fix_summary: Keep normal search and pagination while using LazyForEach with the song data source to avoid eager offscreen row construction.

performance_oracle.definition: Sampled retired-instruction period sum (hw-instructions) attributed to the app process in the complete externally driven measured window.
performance_oracle.comparison: unfixed >= 2.0 * fixed over >= 3 rounds per variant
performance_oracle.workload_notes: All three paired ratios and median must reach 2.0x. Native search requests and list rows are verified in each trial. Both variants use the same 1000-song page size and response-sized pagination;
